title: ValidatorAuthorization — an operator npub authorizes one validator key
description: Signed by the OPERATOR npub, whose own external-account binding must already exist (FD-BP-09). This is a public authorization chain, not recursive validation of validators: the operator proves its identity by the same method everyone else uses, then names a dedicated, rotatable key and the exact method that key is authorized to observe under.

operatorBindingHash.$comment: the artifactId of the operator's OWN ExternalBindingClaim — FD-BP-09 step 1

validatorKey.$comment: DISTINCT from user, treasury, deploy and long-lived operator keys, and rotatable.

endpoint.$comment: EXPLICITLY NON-AUTHORITATIVE product metadata. Acceptance policy is expressed over method hashes and keys, NEVER over hostnames — a reader who resolves identity by hostname has made DNS part of the trust model.
